description: Run an ExtendScript file in After Effects (File > Scripts > Run Script File) as one undo step with dialogs suppressed, or schedule it to run after a delay (optionally repeating) and cancel a scheduled run, or run a script listed in the File > Scripts menu by its file name. Scripts run unrestricted

cancelTask.description: Cancel a scheduled run by the task id it returned

delaySeconds.description: With file: run it this long from now instead of now, and return the task id

file.description: Absolute path to a .jsx, .jsxbin or .js file

repeat.description: With delaySeconds: run again every delaySeconds until cancelled. Default false

scriptsMenuItem.description: Run the script shown in File > Scripts with this name, e.g. "Demo Palette.jsx"

undoName.description: Name of the undo step (Edit > Undo). Default "Run script"

name: run_aftereffects_script_file
title: Run After Effects Script File
